literal: Wencheng Yuan Empress Li was a man of Meng in Liang.
idiomatic: Wencheng Yuan Empress Li was a man of Meng in Liang.

literal: At the empress's birth there was something unusual.
idiomatic: At the empress's birth there was something unusual.

literal: Father Fangshu always said this girl would be greatly honored.
idiomatic: Father Fangshu always said this girl would be greatly honored.

literal: When grown, bearing and quality were beautiful.
idiomatic: When grown, bearing and quality were beautiful.

literal: When Taiwu campaigned south, Prince of Yongchang Ren went out to Shouchun; the army reached the empress's home and thus obtained the empress.
idiomatic: When Taiwu campaigned south, Prince of Yongchang Ren went out to Shouchun; the army reached the empress's home and thus obtained the empress.

literal: When Ren guarded Chang'an, because of an affair he was executed; the empress with her family was sent to Pingcheng Palace.
idiomatic: When Ren guarded Chang'an, because of an affair he was executed; the empress with her family was sent to Pingcheng Palace.

literal: Gaozu ascended the White Tower and saw her—he admired her beauty.
idiomatic: Gaozu ascended the White Tower and saw her—he admired her beauty.

literal: He descended the tower; the empress won favor in the fasting storehouse and became pregnant.
idiomatic: He descended the tower; the empress won favor in the fasting storehouse and became pregnant.

literal: Empress Dowager Chang later questioned the empress and knew it; the storekeeper also privately wrote on the wall and recorded it; separate added interrogation—all matched.
idiomatic: Empress Dowager Chang later questioned the empress and knew it; the storekeeper also privately wrote on the wall and recorded it; separate added interrogation—all matched.

literal: When she bore Xianwen, she was made noble lady.
idiomatic: When she bore Xianwen, she was made noble lady.

literal: In the second year of Tai'an, the empress dowager ordered according to precedent.
idiomatic: In the second year of Tai'an, the empress dowager ordered according to precedent.

literal: She had the empress fully list brothers in the south and the sworn clan brother Hong she had joined—all were entrusted.
idiomatic: She had the empress fully list brothers in the south and the sworn clan brother Hong she had joined—all were entrusted.

literal: At the parting, each time she named a brother she beat her breast and wept bitterly; then she died.
idiomatic: At the parting, each time she named a brother she beat her breast and wept bitterly; then she died.

literal: Posthumous title Yuan Empress; buried at Jinling; paired sacrifice at the Grand Temple.
idiomatic: Posthumous title Yuan Empress; buried at Jinling; paired sacrifice at the Grand Temple.

literal: Xianwen Si Empress Li was a man of Anxi in Zhongshan, daughter of Prince of Nanjun Hui.
idiomatic: Xianwen Si Empress Li was a man of Anxi in Zhongshan, daughter of Prince of Nanjun Hui.

literal: Bearing and virtue gentle and fine, age eighteen.
idiomatic: Bearing and virtue gentle and fine, age eighteen.

literal: By selection she entered the eastern palace.
idiomatic: By selection she entered the eastern palace.

literal: When Xianwen took the throne, she was lady; she bore Xiaowen.
idiomatic: When Xianwen took the throne, she was lady; she bore Xiaowen.

literal: In the third year of Huangxing she died; buried at Jinling.
idiomatic: In the third year of Huangxing she died; buried at Jinling.

literal: In the first year of Chengming posthumous title and honorific were raised; paired sacrifice at the Grand Temple.
idiomatic: In the first year of Chengming posthumous title and honorific were raised; paired sacrifice at the Grand Temple.

literal: Xiaowen Zhen Empress Lin was a man of Pingliang.
idiomatic: Xiaowen Zhen Empress Lin was a man of Pingliang.

literal: Father Sheng, post Pingliang prefect.
idiomatic: Father Sheng, post Pingliang prefect.

literal: Uncle Jinlü rose from eunuch office.
idiomatic: Uncle Jinlü rose from eunuch office.

literal: At the beginning of Xianwen he was Inspector of Dingzhou; executed by Yi Hun; Sheng and brothers all died.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Xianwen he was inspector of Dingzhou; executed by Yi Hun; Sheng and brothers all died.

literal: Sheng had no sons; two daughters entered the rear apartments.
idiomatic: Sheng had no sons; two daughters entered the rear apartments.

literal: The empress's bearing was beautiful; she won Xiaowen's favor and bore the prince Xun.
idiomatic: The empress's bearing was beautiful; she won Xiaowen's favor and bore the prince Xun.

literal: Because Xun would be heir, in the seventh year of Taihe the empress died by the old system.
idiomatic: Because Xun would be heir, in the seventh year of Taihe the empress died by the old system.

literal: The emperor was humane and did not wish to follow the former affair, but followed Civilizing Empress Dowager's intent—thus it was not carried out.
idiomatic: The emperor was humane and did not wish to follow the former affair, but followed Civilizing Empress Dowager's intent—thus it was not carried out.

literal: Posthumous title Zhen Empress; buried at Jinling.
idiomatic: Posthumous title Zhen Empress; buried at Jinling.

literal: When Xun was ordered to die for crime, the authorities memorialized to posthumously depose the empress as commoner.
idiomatic: When Xun was ordered to die for crime, the authorities memorialized to posthumously depose the empress as commoner.

literal: Xiaowen's deposed Empress Feng was daughter of Grand Tutor Xi.
idiomatic: Xiaowen's deposed Empress Feng was daughter of Grand Tutor Xi.

literal: In the seventeenth year of Taihe, when Xiaowen had ended mourning, Grand Marshal Yuan Pi and others memorialized that the chief autumn was not yet set and the six palaces had no master—please rectify the inner place.
idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Taihe, when Xiaowen had ended mourning, Grand Marshal Yuan Pi and others memorialized that the chief autumn was not yet set and the six palaces had no master—please rectify the inner place.

literal: Xiaowen followed; he established the empress; favor was very thick.
idiomatic: Xiaowen followed; he established the empress; favor was very thick.

literal: Xiaowen later brought the empress's elder sister zhaoyi to Luoyang; she gradually won some favor; the empress's loving courtesy gradually declined.
idiomatic: Xiaowen later brought the empress's elder sister zhaoyi to Luoyang; she gradually won some favor; the empress's loving courtesy gradually declined.

literal: The zhaoyi, because she was older and had earlier entered the palace, was always treated with thought; she slighted the empress and did not follow concubine ritual.
idiomatic: The zhaoyi, because she was older and had earlier entered the palace, was always treated with thought; she slighted the empress and did not follow concubine ritual.

literal: Though the empress was not jealous by nature, at times she had a look of shame and resentment.
idiomatic: Though the empress was not jealous by nature, at times she had a look of shame and resentment.

literal: The zhaoyi schemed to be inner mistress; slander in a hundred ways—soon the empress was deposed as commoner.
idiomatic: The zhaoyi schemed to be inner mistress; slander in a hundred ways—soon the empress was deposed as commoner.

literal: The empress was chaste, careful, and of moral conduct; she became a practicing nun at Yaoguang Buddhist Temple and ended there.
idiomatic: The empress was chaste, careful, and of moral conduct; she became a practicing nun at Yaoguang Buddhist Temple and ended there.

literal: Xiaowen You Empress was also Feng Xi's daughter.
idiomatic: Xiaowen You Empress was also Feng Xi's daughter.

literal: Mother was Lady Chang.
idiomatic: Mother was Lady Chang.

literal: Originally base and slight, she won Xi's favor; after the primary consort princess died, she then managed the household.
idiomatic: Originally base and slight, she won Xi's favor; after the primary consort princess died, she then managed the household.

literal: She bore the empress and Prince of Beiping Su.
idiomatic: She bore the empress and Prince of Beiping Su.

literal: Civilizing Grand Empress Dowager wished the clan honored; she chose two of Xi's daughters; both entered the rear apartments, age fourteen then.
idiomatic: Civilizing Grand Empress Dowager wished the clan honored; she chose two of Xi's daughters; both entered the rear apartments, age fourteen then.

literal: One died early.
idiomatic: One died early.

literal: The empress had charm and was especially loved.
idiomatic: The empress had charm and was especially loved.

literal: Before long, illness.
idiomatic: Before long, illness.

literal: The empress dowager sent her home to be a nun; the emperor still kept her in mind.
idiomatic: The empress dowager sent her home to be a nun; the emperor still kept her in mind.

literal: After more than a year the empress dowager died; when the emperor ended mourning, he greatly sought her.
idiomatic: After more than a year the empress dowager died; when the emperor ended mourning, he greatly sought her.

literal: Also hearing the empress's chronic rash was cured, he sent eunuch Shuang Sannian with imperial writ to comfort and ask; then welcomed her to Luoyang.
idiomatic: Also hearing the empress's chronic rash was cured, he sent eunuch Shuang Sannian with imperial writ to comfort and ask; then welcomed her to Luoyang.

literal: When she arrived, favor exceeded the first time.
idiomatic: When she arrived, favor exceeded the first time.

literal: That evening palace people rarely again entered audience.
idiomatic: That evening palace people rarely again entered audience.

literal: She was made left zhaoyi; later established empress.
idiomatic: She was made left zhaoyi; later established empress.

literal: The emperor campaigned south year after year; the empress then privately disordered with palace eunuch Gao Pusa.
idiomatic: The emperor campaigned south year after year; the empress then privately disordered with palace eunuch Gao Pusa.

literal: When the emperor was unwell at Ruyang, afterward she openly was shameless; Palace Regular Attendant Shuang Meng and others were her intimate confidants.
idiomatic: When the emperor was unwell at Ruyang, afterward she openly was shameless; Palace Regular Attendant Shuang Meng and others were her intimate confidants.

literal: At the time Princess of Pengcheng, daughter-in-law of Song Prince Liu Chang, was young and widowed.
idiomatic: At the time Princess of Pengcheng, daughter-in-law of Song Prince Liu Chang, was young and widowed.

literal: Prince of Beiping Feng Su was the empress's younger uterine brother.
idiomatic: Prince of Beiping Feng Su was the empress's younger uterine brother.

literal: The empress asked marriage of Xiaowen; Xiaowen assented.
idiomatic: The empress asked marriage of Xiaowen; Xiaowen assented.

literal: The princess's will was unwilling; the empress wished to force it—the wedding had a day.
idiomatic: The princess's will was unwilling; the empress wished to force it—the wedding had a day.

literal: The princess secretly with maidservants and bond servants more than ten persons took a light carriage, braved pouring rain, went to Xuanhuai, paid homage to Xiaowen, and stated her original intent.
idiomatic: The princess secretly with maidservants and bond servants more than ten persons took a light carriage, braved pouring rain, went to Xuanhuai, paid homage to Xiaowen, and stated her original intent.

literal: She also spoke of the empress's disorder with Pusa.
idiomatic: She also spoke of the empress's disorder with Pusa.

literal: The emperor heard and was startled, did not yet believe, but kept it secret.
idiomatic: The emperor heard and was startled, did not yet believe, but kept it secret.

literal: After this the empress gradually grew fearful.
idiomatic: After this the empress gradually grew fearful.

literal: With mother Chang she sought a witch, praying Xiaowen's illness would not recover;
idiomatic: With mother Chang she sought a witch, praying Xiaowen's illness would not recover;

literal: if one day she could like Civilizing Empress Dowager assist the young lord and hold command, reward would be beyond price.
idiomatic: if one day she could like Civilizing Empress Dowager assist the young lord and hold command, reward would be beyond price.

literal: Also she took three sacrificial beasts for palace Hu worship, falsely saying to pray for blessing, devoted to heterodox ways.
idiomatic: Also she took three sacrificial beasts for palace Hu worship, falsely saying to pray for blessing, devoted to heterodox ways.

literal: Mother Chang sometimes went herself to the palace, or sent maidservants to answer back and forth.
idiomatic: Mother Chang sometimes went herself to the palace, or sent maidservants to answer back and forth.

literal: When the emperor reached Luo, he interrogated Pusa, Shuang Meng and others; the full circumstances were obtained.
idiomatic: When the emperor reached Luo, he interrogated Pusa, Shuang Meng and others; the full circumstances were obtained.

literal: The emperor lay ill in the Warm Chamber; at night he summoned the empress and lined up Pusa and others outside the door.
idiomatic: The emperor lay ill in the Warm Chamber; at night he summoned the empress and lined up Pusa and others outside the door.

literal: As the empress entered, he ordered search in her clothes—if there was a inch blade, cut at once.
idiomatic: As the empress entered, he ordered search in her clothes—if there was an inch blade, cut at once.

literal: The empress knocked head and wept in apology; then she was granted seat on the east pillar, more than two zhang from the imperial mat.
idiomatic: The empress knocked head and wept in apology; then she was granted seat on the east pillar, more than two zhang from the imperial mat.

literal: Xiaowen ordered Pusa and the rest to state the case; again he reproached the empress: "You have witchcraft—state it fully."
idiomatic: Xiaowen ordered Pusa and the rest to state the case; again he reproached the empress, "You have witchcraft—state it fully."

literal: The empress begged to screen attendants—there was a secret report.
idiomatic: The empress begged to screen attendants—there was a secret report.

literal: Xiaowen ordered all palace attendants out; only Chief of Autumn Bai Zheng at the side, taking guard straight blade to lean on it.
idiomatic: Xiaowen ordered all palace attendants out; only Chief of Autumn Bai Zheng at the side, taking guard straight blade to lean on it.

literal: The empress still did not speak.
idiomatic: The empress still did not speak.

literal: Gaozu then stuffed Zheng's ears with cotton firmly, himself calling Zheng softly three times—no response—then ordered the empress to speak.
idiomatic: Gaozu then stuffed Zheng's ears with cotton firmly, himself calling Zheng softly three times—no response—then ordered the empress to speak.

literal: The affair was hidden; men did not know it.
idiomatic: The affair was hidden; men did not know it.

literal: Gaozu then summoned Princes of Pengcheng and Beihai to enter and sit, saying: "Formerly she was your sister-in-law; now she is another's—only enter, do not avoid."
idiomatic: Gaozu then summoned Princes of Pengcheng and Beihai to enter and sit, saying, "Formerly she was your sister-in-law; now she is another's—only enter, do not avoid."

literal: Also he said: "This old woman wished to insert a white blade in my ribs—exhaustively ask the root; do not have difficulty."
idiomatic: Also he said, "This old woman wished to insert a white blade in my ribs—exhaustively ask the root; do not have difficulty."

literal: Also he said: "The Feng family's daughter cannot again be deposed and driven off; let her sit empty in the palace—if she has heart she can die herself—you must not think I still have feeling."
idiomatic: Also he said, "The Feng family's daughter cannot again be deposed and driven off; let her sit empty in the palace—if she has heart she can die herself—you must not think I still have feeling."

literal: The emperor by nature was utmost filial; still because of Civilizing Empress Dowager he did not carry out deposition.
idiomatic: The emperor by nature was utmost filial; still because of Civilizing Empress Dowager he did not carry out deposition.

literal: The two princes left; then he granted the empress words of farewell to death; again bowing head and weeping.
idiomatic: The two princes left; then he granted the empress words of farewell to death; again bowing head and weeping.

literal: After entering the palace the emperor ordered palace attendants to question the empress; the empress cursed: "I am the Son of Heaven's wife—I should face him—how can I let you transmit!"
idiomatic: After entering the palace the emperor ordered palace attendants to question the empress; the empress cursed, "I am the Son of Heaven's wife—I should face him—how can I let you transmit!"

literal: The emperor was angry; he ordered the empress's mother Chang in; showed her the empress's case; Chang flogged her more than a hundred strokes then stopped.
idiomatic: The emperor was angry; he ordered the empress's mother Chang in; showed her the empress's case; Chang flogged her more than a hundred strokes then stopped.

literal: The emperor soon campaigned south and stayed at the capital.
idiomatic: The emperor soon campaigned south and stayed at the capital.

literal: Though she lost favor for crime, ladies and pin still served her by law.
idiomatic: Though she lost favor for crime, ladies and pin still served her by law.

literal: Only Shizong in the eastern palace had no court audience affairs.
idiomatic: Only Shizong in the eastern palace had no court audience affairs.

literal: The emperor was very ill and told Prince of Pengcheng Xie: "The rear palace long lacked yin virtue and cut itself off from Heaven—after my death grant her to end herself in a separate palace; bury with empress ritual—perhaps to cover the Feng gate's great fault."
idiomatic: The emperor was very ill and told Prince of Pengcheng Xie, "The rear palace long lacked yin virtue and cut itself off from Heaven—after my death grant her to end herself in a separate palace; bury with empress ritual—perhaps to cover the Feng gate's great fault."

literal: When the emperor died, the coffin reached Luyang; then the last edict was carried out.
idiomatic: When the emperor died, the coffin reached Luyang; then the last edict was carried out.

literal: Prince of Beihai Xiang received and proclaimed the last will; Chief of Autumn Bai Zheng and others entered and gave the empress the drug.
idiomatic: Prince of Beihai Xiang received and proclaimed the last will; Chief of Autumn Bai Zheng and others entered and gave the empress the drug.

literal: The empress ran shouting, refusing to take resolution, saying: "How can the ruler have this!
idiomatic: The empress ran shouting, refusing to take resolution, saying, "How can the ruler have this!

literal: These kings killed me."
idiomatic: These kings killed me."

literal: Zheng and the rest held and forced her; then she took pepper and died.
idiomatic: Zheng and the rest held and forced her; then she took pepper and died.

literal: When the coffin next reached south of Luo, Prince of Xianyang Xi and others knew the true death and looked at each other: "Without the last edict, we brothers would also have made a plan to remove her.
idiomatic: When the coffin next reached south of Luo, Prince of Xianyang Xi and others knew the true death and looked at each other, "Without the last edict, we brothers would also have made a plan to remove her.

literal: How could we let a woman of lost conduct rule the realm and kill us?"
idiomatic: How could we let a woman of lost conduct rule the realm and kill us?"

literal: Posthumous title You Empress; buried within Changling mound.
idiomatic: Posthumous title You Empress; buried within Changling mound.

literal: Later the authorities memorialized to add title; posthumous title Wenzhao noble lady.
idiomatic: Later the authorities memorialized to add title; posthumous title Wenzhao noble lady.

literal: Xuanwu followed it.
idiomatic: Xuanwu followed it.

literal: When Xuanwu took the throne, he posthumously honored paired sacrifice.
idiomatic: When Xuanwu took the throne, he posthumously honored paired sacrifice.

literal: The empress was first buried southeast of Changling; the tomb system was low and cramped; therefore a mountain tomb was raised nearby, called Zhongning Tomb.
idiomatic: The empress was first buried southeast of Changling; the tomb system was low and cramped; therefore a mountain tomb was raised nearby, called Zhongning Tomb.

literal: Five hundred settlement households were set.
idiomatic: Five hundred settlement households were set.
